front: In Amazon SQS, a queue keeps a message for {{c1::4 days}} by default.
extra: A message that is older than the retention period is deleted unread.

front: In Amazon SQS, the longest message retention period is {{c1::14 days}}.
In Amazon SQS, the default visibility timeout is {{c1::30 seconds}}.
extra: A job that runs longer than the timeout lets a second consumer receive the same message.

front: In Amazon SQS, the longest visibility timeout is {{c1::12 hours}}.
extra: The limit counts from the ReceiveMessage request. Extending the timeout does not reset it.

front: In Amazon SQS, the longest wait time of one long-polling ReceiveMessage call is {{c1::20 seconds}}.
extra: Any wait time greater than zero turns on long polling.

front: In Amazon SQS, the longest delay of a delay queue is {{c1::15 minutes}}.
extra: For a later start, AWS recommends EventBridge Scheduler.

front: In an SQS FIFO queue, the default throughput without batching is {{c1::300 messages per second}}.
extra: The default rises to [3,000 messages per second with batching](../facts/sqs.md#sqs-faq-fifo-default-throughput-3000-with-batching-300-without).

front: In Amazon EventBridge, the maximum number of targets of one rule is {{c1::5}}.
extra: The quota is not adjustable. More receivers need a second rule or an SNS topic as a target.
